_source: Peitho's 'Santa & Sol — Booking Page Copy' (rev 130, Oct 16 2026) plus Viv's edits on the approved v3 design. Text in [TBD: …], [NEEDS PROOF] or [ASSUMPTION] renders as a visible staging marker. **Double asterisks** render bold.

header.logoAlt: Santa & Sol, Costa Rica Christmas Portraits

hero.headline: A Christmas photo
hero.headlineAccent: only Costa Rica could give you.
hero.subhead: A private sunset session with a barefoot Santa on your favorite beach. Five professional photos in your online gallery within 48 hours, ready to turn into cards and send to family back home.
hero.imageAlt: A family of five with a barefoot Santa in a striped shirt, under the palms on the beach at sunset

session.headline: Santa saved
session.body: Santa & Sol is a **private Christmas portrait session at sunset**. For eight minutes, Santa is there just for you and your family, while Laurel photographs you in golden-hour light.
session.cardsHeader: The card that has everyone back home checking flights.
session.cardsBody: Your five photos land in your online gallery within 48 hours. Pick a favorite, design your card online, and get it printed and mailed to your loved ones.
session.imageAlt: Santa in a striped shirt, straw hat and bare feet, sitting on a bench beside a dressed Christmas tree on the beach at sunset

points.title: A photo worth framing.
points.body: Not a snapshot on the sand: a portrait of your family with Santa, shot by a professional photographer in sunset light. The one you'll want on your own wall.

points.title: Eight unhurried minutes, all yours.
points.body: Long enough for Laurel to capture the photos you'll love, short enough that the kids don't get restless. Your time with Santa is booked just for you.

points.title: In your gallery within 48 hours.
points.body: Your photos are in your gallery within 48 hours of your session, so there's time to order cards and mail them before Christmas [TBD: card service's last order date].

steps.title: Book your sunset slot.
steps.body: Pick a beach and date. $95 per family.

steps.title: Meet Santa at sunset.
steps.body: Eight relaxed minutes with Santa, the kids and the dog, in golden-hour light. Arrive 15 minutes early to settle in.

steps.title: Get your photos within 48 hours.
steps.body: Five professional photos land in your online gallery. Order extra photos or cards right from there.

photographer.headline: Laurel,
photographer.body: Photographer, mother, lover of golden hour. Laurel photographs families, couples, weddings and retreats across Costa Rica. She works quietly, with no stiff posing, and lets the light and your family do the rest.

dates.headline: Pick your beach.
dates.lead: First sunsets: Nov 13, 14 and 15. When a date's slots are gone, it's full, and new dates open as families sign up.
dates.santaOptionalUnder: Skipping Santa? The Christmas props still come along.

dates.pattern: Every weekend we open: Friday in Flamingo, Saturday at Playa Grande, Sunday in Tamarindo.

included: A private 8-minute sunset slot with a barefoot Santa
Five professionally edited, high-res photos in an online gallery

addOns: Christmas cards designed from your gallery and mailed to family: [TBD price, countries, last order date]
offer.imageAlt: A boy and a girl hanging ornaments on a Christmas tree on the beach at golden hour

items.q: When will we get our photos?
items.a: Your photos are in your online gallery within 48 hours of your session. For mailed cards, order from your gallery by [TBD: card service's last order date].
It's one flat price for a private slot, a barefoot Santa, a professional photographer and five finished photos. Extra photos and cards are optional.
It's your own booked slot, so the time with Santa is all yours. Long enough for Laurel to capture the photos you'll love, short enough that the kids don't get restless.
Yes, at our Tamarindo and Flamingo sessions (Fri & Sun).
December is dry season in Guanacaste. If we have to cancel a session for weather, we'll move you to another date. [TBD: confirm what happens if no date works]

items.q: Will Santa be hot in that suit?
items.a: Very. He's from the North Pole. He's doing his best.
Please arrive 15 minutes before your slot to settle in and get ready. If you're running late, we'll try to fit you in at the end of the session, but we can't guarantee it.
Sessions are paid in full when you book. If your plans change, we'll do our best to move you to another date, but we can't guarantee a new slot. Missed sessions aren't refunded.

items.q: Can cards be mailed to Canada or Europe?
items.a: [TBD: depends on where the card service mails to]
As many as you like. Bring the whole family.

closing.headline: Send a little sunshine home
closing.body: Limited sunsets this season. Pick yours.
